intro: The Affray is a brutal martial trial conducted on Fray Island off the coast of the Barrens. Administered by Klannoc Macleod, this arena brawl pits ambitious warriors against waves of island challengers and their champion to prove they possess the mettle required for advanced training.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray. It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising adventurers who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.
To begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate. That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.
Beat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will. Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You have passed The Affray!
You are a worthy adventurer, and I am honored to teach you...

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
